h1: The 5 Best Stainless Steel Electric Kettles of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Stainless Steel Kettles: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: five stainless steel electric kettles compared on capacity, wattage, double-wall build and temperature control for tea.
summary: The COMFEE' 1.7L, 1500W kettle is our pick for most kitchens. The Cosori with temperature control is the choice for tea drinkers, the Cosori double-wall model adds a cooler exterior at 1.5L, and the Amazon Basics 1L suits one-person households.
intro: Search for a stainless steel kettle and you will see glass and plastic models mixed in, with the word steel sitting in the title. Material is the first thing to verify, because it affects taste, weight and how hot the outside gets.

We reviewed eight listings and kept five where the data confirms stainless steel. A glass-bodied Cosori, a plastic Cosori and a Cuisinart with no stated material were dropped, since they do not deliver what the title promises.

products.name: COMFEE' Stainless Steel Electric Kettle
products.verdict: A 1.7L, 1500W stainless kettle with clear specs.
products.description:
The COMFEE' is a stainless steel kettle rated at 1500W with a 1.7 liter capacity, priced in the $25-50 bracket.

It leads because it states material, wattage and capacity plainly and sits at the same price as the Hamilton Beach. The 1500W rating is the standard for quick boiling.

Best for a household that boils water daily. It lacks the temperature settings of the Cosori below.
products.skipIf: You need set temperatures for tea.

products.name: Cosori Stainless Steel Electric Kettle with Temperature Control
products.verdict: Stainless steel with temperature control at 1.7L.
products.description:
This Cosori is a stainless steel kettle with temperature control and a 1.7 liter capacity, in the $50-100 bracket.

Second place comes down to price: it costs a bracket above the COMFEE'. The temperature control is the reason to pay it, since green and white teas prefer cooler water than a full boil.

Best for tea and pour-over coffee. The listing gives no wattage or preset list, so check it before buying.

products.name: Cosori Stainless Steel Electric Kettle
products.description:
This Cosori uses double-wall stainless construction with a 1.5 liter capacity, in the $25-50 bracket.

It ranks third because 1.5 liters is a little smaller than the 1.7 liter picks above. The double-wall build is the draw, as it is designed to keep the outside cooler.

Best for homes with kids or tight counters. Wattage is not listed on our data.

products.name: Hamilton Beach 1.7 Liter Electric Tea Kettle
products.verdict: A 1.7L stainless steel kettle from a familiar brand.
products.description:
The Hamilton Beach is a 1.7 liter stainless steel kettle in the $25-50 bracket. The listing gives no wattage.

It ranks fourth because the COMFEE' offers the same capacity and bracket while stating its 1500W. The brand name is its edge.

Best for buyers who prefer a household brand. Confirm wattage on the listing.
products.skipIf: You want a stated power rating.

products.name: Amazon Basics Electric Stainless Steel Kettle for Tea and Coffee
products.verdict: A 1L, 1500W stainless kettle for small households.
products.description:
The Amazon Basics kettle is stainless steel, 1500W and 1 liter, in the $25-50 bracket.

It ranks last because 1 liter is the smallest here, though the wattage matches the COMFEE'. A smaller body means faster use for a cup or two.

Best for one or two people. Large households will be refilling often.

whatMatters.detail: Some titles say stainless steel while the body is glass or plastic. Confirm the material in the bullets. Steel resists cracking and does not retain flavors.
Capacity is how much water fits. 1 liter suits a mug or two, while 1.7 liters covers a family pot of tea. Look for the liter figure.
Wattage drives boil speed. 1500W is a common rating for quick heating. Check whether the listing states a number.
Double-wall steel adds insulation between inner and outer layers, so the exterior stays cooler. Look for the words double-wall.
Set temperatures let you brew delicate teas below boiling. Look for it in the title, as only one pick lists it.

faq.q: Are all of these fully stainless steel?
faq.a: The listings confirm stainless steel bodies for all five. Check for plastic lids or parts on the live page.
Trusting the title. Several listings with stainless steel in the name were glass or plastic, so we dropped them.
If you drink green or white tea, yes. Otherwise the COMFEE' is enough.

faq.q: How do I descale a kettle?
faq.a: Use a vinegar or citric acid solution as the maker advises, then rinse well.

faq.q: How big should my kettle be?
faq.a: 1 liter for one or two, 1.5 to 1.7 liters for families.

faq.q: Does a double-wall kettle stay cool?
faq.a: It is designed for a cooler outside, but the lid and spout still get hot.

finalTake: The COMFEE' is the best all-round stainless kettle here. The Cosori with temperature control is the tea drinker's choice, and the Amazon Basics suits small households. Confirm material and capacity before ordering.
